description: A tick on every slot boundary 0..n: tall (month) where a month starts, the outer two plain. month is the month labelled from that boundary: each month start, and the first month in view at the left edge, unless the next label starts less than 2 slots after it, where the earlier one is dropped.

cases.name: month labels at the left edge and where a month starts
a month starting at the left edge is plain there, but labelled
a new year is a new month, the left edge's name giving way to it
the same month in another year, the left edge's name giving way to it
the left edge's month gives way to one starting a slot in
two slots in, both are labelled
a month with one day in view gives way to the next
